tools.name: search_conforming_limits
tools.description: Look up the FHFA conforming loan limit for a US county in calendar year 2026 — the maximum loan Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac will buy, for 1- to 4-unit properties. Covers all 3235 counties and county equivalents. Returns the baseline for counties with no special designation, and flags the 160 high-cos

tools.name: mortgage_payment
tools.description: Fixed-rate, fully amortising mortgage: equal monthly payment of principal and interest. Returns the monthly P&I, the lifetime interest, the total paid, and what share of the first payment is interest. Optionally adds monthly property tax, insurance and HOA to the total. Use this instead of estimatin
